test_title: PYST 16 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: In a warehouse, there are 3 stacks of bricks. The average weight of the bricks in Stack A is 112.5 kg, in Stack B is 118.75 kg, and in Stack C is 107.25 kg. If Stack A has 12 bricks, Stack B has 8 bricks, and Stack C has 16 bricks, find the overall average weight of all bricks in the warehouse.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of number of **bricks** in Stack A : B : C = 12 : 8 : 16 = 3 : 2 : 4.

Assume base average = 110 kg.

Net Deviation = [3 × (112.5 − 110)] + [2 × (118.75 − 110)] + [4 × (107.25 − 110)]

Net Deviation = [3 × 2.5] + [2 × 8.75] + [4 × (−2.75)] = 7.5 + 17.5 − 11 = 14.

Overall Average = 110 + (14 ÷ 9) = 110 + 1.555... ≈ 111.55 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 111.55 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Stack A: 12 bricks at 112.5 kg | Stack B: 8 bricks at 118.75 kg | Stack C: 16 bricks at 107.25 kg

**Formula Used:**

Overall Average = (Total Weight) ÷ (Total Number of Bricks)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3c10e1fbea68f744c0bf528c8ed3f2f9df73a8bd479f9c445613bdb499745b3.png] 

⇒ Total weight of Stack A = 12 × 112.5 = 1350 kg

⇒ Total weight of Stack B = 8 × 118.75 = 950 kg

⇒ Total weight of Stack C = 16 × 107.25 = 1716 kg

⇒ Total Weight of all bricks = 1350 + 950 + 1716 = 4016 kg

⇒ Total number of bricks = 12 + 8 + 16 = 36

⇒ Overall Average = 4016 ÷ 36

⇒ Overall Average = 1004 ÷ 9 = 111.555...

**∴ The correct answer is 111.55 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

The weighted average is calculated as (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ... + wₙxₙ) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ... + wₙ), where w is the weight (quantity) and x is the value.

Deviation Method

New Average = Assumed Average + (Net Deviation ÷ Total Count). This simplifies calculations by using smaller numbers.

Average Property

If every value in a set is increased or decreased by a constant k, the **overall average** also increases or decreases by k.
